## Requirements (extracted from the ticket body)

1. Complete §5.9 token set in `packages/tokens` — every `:root` row; full light theme (every token, hues re-tuned); `[data-paper="light"|"dark"|"follow"]` pinning inside either shell; 4-pt spacing + radius 4/8/12; **no pure black/white**; contrast invariants as unit tests (shell body ≥7:1, paper body ≥10:1, chips ≥4.5:1, non-text marks ≥3:1).
2. Theme policy (REQ-IDE-38 amended): app theme Dark(default)/Light/Auto, detected on first run, remembered per user, identical landing→app; **no wrong-theme flash** — boot script stamps `data-theme`/`data-paper` before first paint. Paper pinned Light(default)/follow/pinned Dark per project (`projects.paper_theme`, default 'light'), `⌘⇧L` cycles; pinned-light paper renders inset with 1-px border + shadow.
3. Typography (REQ-IDE-39): paper Literata 17/1.55 (Lora fallback; serif default) or Inter 16/1.55 (sans preset, only other choice); headings 600 at 2.0/1.625/1.375/1.125em; paragraph spacing 1em no indent; shell Inter 13/14/12 + tabular figures; JetBrains Mono 13 for citation keys/diff hunks; reader stepper ±2px, 3 steps, persisted; print 11pt/1.4/6.5in measure. Font loading wired to the preset.
4. Pane system (REQ-IDE-8): exactly seven regions — Rail (56px, hides only in Focus; project switcher + Inbox badge slot), **Files** (36px icon strip default, `⌘1`), Page (always visible), Margin (only when findings; ticks-only <1280px), Timeline (`⌘2`), Desk (bottom drawer, closed default, auto-opens on Live feed at run start, `⌘J`), Status bar. **Yield order as a pure tested function of viewport width**: Files open <1600 ⇒ Margin→ticks; <1600 Timeline→overlay while Files open, otherwise last to yield; <1280 Margin→ticks + Timeline→overlay; <1024 single-column + Timeline→sheet; <~768 phone layout (reader-only Page; breakpoint + fallback only — inputs are P1.19).
5. Resize + Page clamp (REQ-IDE-9): Files/Timeline drag handles with snap points; Page never <45ch or >80ch (68ch target); a violating drag collapses the adjacent pane. Pane state per user per project, restored on reopen, **local state, never in URL** (localStorage chosen — recorded).
6. Focus mode (`⌘⇧F` → Page + finding ticks only) + the one View menu (`⌘⇧M`): Write·Read·Focus + *Finding cards* on/off + *Show suggestions inline* inside Write/Read; **Source absent** (1.x). `?focus=1` on shared URLs toggles Focus.
7. Progressive disclosure (REQ-IDE-10): Default/On demand/Advanced classification on every shell control; Advanced behind a persisted per-user disclosure; Advanced never gates a workflow. Ship mechanism + classification table; contents arrive with owning surfaces.
8. Motion (REQ-IDE-40): tokenized durations — stream block fade 120ms + caret pulse, phase progress 160ms, finding arrival 200ms slide+tick pulse, pane transitions 160ms, approval countdown numeric-only amber at 5min; no decorative motion on the paper; `prefers-reduced-motion` → instant (tested).
9. State catalogue (REQ-IDE-41): empty project (3 entry cards + quiet serif title), empty findings ("No review yet · Review v1 ≈ N cr"), streaming (block shimmer, live counters, syncing pill), loading (shell skeleton rows — never spinners on paper), run failed (red card w/ phase, reason, partials, refund line, Resume), sync offline ("offline · n changes queued" pill), conflict (inline banner, never modal), insufficient balance (button swap only), frozen version (lock banner). **The only blocking modal is Cancel-run** — encoded as a rule (test/lint), not convention.
10. A11y (REQ-IDE-42): WCAG 2.2 AA + AAA reading contrast; 2-px accent focus rings; no colour-only encoding (severity pairs hue+weight/text); full keyboard operability; findings/approvals as ARIA landmarks, `aria-live="polite"` (assertive for spend gates); 200% text resize without horizontal scroll; Desk findings table designated the SR surface (landmark wiring + aria-hidden/aria-describedby contract for margin decorations — table itself is P1.07).
11. Host ruling — RECORDED (ADR): keep Hono SSR + `renderToStaticMarkup` + esbuild islands; IDE mounts as one hydrated React subtree at `/p/:project*` (second esbuild entry `src/client/ide.tsx` → `public/ide.js`); no React Router framework-mode rewrite (§13.1 out of scope). Same-origin data only.
12. Cutover: `/p/:project` renders the IDE shell; deep links (`/v/:n`, `/v/working`, `/v/:n/diff/:m`, `/r/:run`, `/r/:run/g/:gate`, `/f/:findingId`, `/a/:artifactId`, `/chat[/:thread]`) resolve inside it with focus target; beta flat sub-pages keep working; nothing 404s.
13. `turbo build lint typecheck` + `pnpm test` green; licenses + protocol-markers clean; vocabulary lint covers new strings (Files, Desk, Write·Read·Focus).

## Plan

- **`@rhema/tokens`**: complete `LIGHT_VARS` (every key, hues re-tuned ≥4.5:1); add `LAYOUT` (§5.1 width math + breakpoints), `MOTION` (named durations), typography extension (presets, stepper, print), `contrast.ts` (WCAG luminance/ratio), `theme-css.ts` extended (`[data-paper]` pinning, font-face + preset vars, focus rings, reduced-motion, print, paper sheet inset), `ide-css.ts` (pane stylesheet generated from `LAYOUT`).
- **`@rhema/ide` (new, framework-free)**: `layout.ts` (`paneLayout(width,state)` yield order + `applyPaneDrag` clamp-collapse + snap), `pane-store.ts` (codec + localStorage seam `rhema:pane:v1:<user>:<project>`), `theme.ts` (AppTheme/PaperTheme, resolve/cycle, storage keys), `boot.ts` (the synchronous pre-paint boot script string), `disclosure.ts` (the §5.1 classification table), `view-menu.ts` (Write·Read·Focus + the two toggles; Source absent).
- **`@rhema/ui`**: `ide-shell.tsx` (the seven-region SSR+hydratable React shell, keyboard, persisted state, View menu, disclosure), `ide-states.tsx` (the §5.9 state catalogue + `CancelRunConfirm`, the only modal), exports.
- **`@rhema/api-client`**: `paperTheme` on `ProjectRow`; `getTheme`/`setTheme`/`setPaperTheme` DTOs + methods.
- **`@rhema/db`**: migration `0027_user_app_theme.sql` (`"user".app_theme` ∈ dark/light/auto, default 'dark') + drizzle schema.
- **`apps/api`**: `GET/POST /settings/theme` (settings-routes.ts; the privacy-toggle pattern), `PATCH /projects/:id/paper-theme` + `paper_theme` on the project list read.
- **`apps/web`**: `renderDocument` gains the boot script + `data-theme`/`data-paper`/`data-app-theme` stamping + ide css/bundle hooks; `ide.tsx` (IdePage element + `buildIdeView`); server routes — `/p/:project` now renders the IDE, deep-link routes resolve inside it, `POST /p/:project/paper-theme`, `POST /settings/theme`, `GET /assets/ide.js`, `GET /assets/fonts/:name`; `client/ide.tsx` island (`hydrateRoot`); `build-client.mjs` second entry + font copy; `COPY.ide` strings; DataSource additions.
- **ADR-012**: host-architecture ruling (keep Hono SSR + islands; no RR framework mode).
- Existing flat pages keep the flat `Shell` — superseded on `/p/:project*` IDE routes only (append-only rule).

## Evidence report

Stage A is complete and deterministic-green. The §5.9 design system lands as a single token table
(`@rhema/tokens`) consumed by every scope — public pages, the flat workspace shell, and the IDE — so
landing and app can never disagree on color (REQ-GROWTH-2 token half). The §5.1 pane system is split the
way the ticket asked: pure, tested logic in `@rhema/ide` (yield order, drag clamps, codecs, theme policy,
disclosure table) under SSR-static attribute-driven markup in `@rhema/ui`'s `IdeShell`, enhanced by the
`ide.js` island — the second esbuild entry after the editor's, per ADR-012's recorded ruling. Theme +
paper prefs persist server-side (`user.app_theme`, `projects.paper_theme` via migration 0027) with
localStorage mirrors so the inline boot script resolves them before first paint — no wrong-theme flash.
Stage B (deploy `dev` + headless verify + operator click-through) is deferred as D-P1.01-1 per the
ticket's own gating; the spec-scheme deep links defer to their owning surfaces as D-P1.01-2.
